text: A series of four learning notes for officials in Indian city governments: climate fundamentals, adaptation actions, urban climate finance, and institutionalising climate action; the adaptation note covers resilience to heat, flooding and water stress.

text: Learning note 2 shows a city how to report results by pairing what it builds (an output, such as the number of roofs treated, hectares of green cover added or cooling centres created) with what changes for people (an outcome, such as lower indoor temperatures and less heat illness).
